craft_notes: Sthāyin: objection raised. Rows: gained then what-again. Rejected: incantation-free drift — killed: not in L3. Read aloud: doubt.

lines: Which, they cry: gained in waveless mounting,
by placing and the rest — thus.
l4.sanskrit_cite: yad āhuḥ ataraṅgarūḍhau labdhāyāṃ punaḥ kiṃ tattvasṛṣṭir nyāsādinā iti
